name: cognos-to-sigma
description: Migrate IBM Cognos Analytics to Sigma — Data Module JSON and Framework Manager project XML → Sigma data model, and report-spec XML → Sigma workbook. Framework Manager converts one presentation subject area at a time, resolving shortcuts to physical tables and keeping role-playing dimension aliases distinct. Translates the Cognos expression DSL (total..for, if/then/else, CASE, date/string fns) and flags what it can't (runtime macros, DMR hierarchies, determinants, parameter maps). Companion to the other sigma-migration-skills converters.
